title: Robinhood stock surges: Why HOOD is rallying and what Wall Street sees next - Robinhood Stock Surges | The Economic Times
text:
Shares of Robinhood Markets jumped nearly 17% on Thursday, making it one of the strongest performers in the S&P 500. The rally came as Wall Street analysts turned more bullish on the fintech platform, while strength in cryptocurrencies added to investor enthusiasm. (Sources: TradingView, Piper Sandler, Morgan Stanley)

A key catalyst behind the rally was growing optimism around Robinhood's prediction-market business. Deutsche Bank highlighted prediction markets as an important growth opportunity, particularly as financial and event-based contracts gain wider acceptance among investors.

Scotiabank initiated coverage of Robinhood with an Outperform rating and a $136 price target. The brokerage believes investors may be valuing Robinhood too heavily as a cyclical retail broker while overlooking its expanding and potentially more stable sources of revenue.

Piper Sandler raised its price target on Robinhood to $145 from $135 while maintaining an Overweight rating. Analyst Patrick Moley expects prediction-market activity to accelerate as the NFL and NCAA football seasons get underway, potentially creating another meaningful revenue opportunity.

Morgan Stanley upgraded Robinhood to Overweight from Equal-Weight and raised its price target to $150 from $124. The firm pointed to Robinhood's expanding product portfolio, rising customer assets and multiple new growth engines beyond its traditional brokerage business.

The bullish case for Robinhood is increasingly moving beyond stock and cryptocurrency trading. The company has been expanding into net interest income, subscriptions, exchange and clearing services, wealth management, banking and crypto infrastructure, helping diversify its revenue base.

The upcoming NFL and college football seasons could provide another boost to Robinhood's prediction markets. The company has already seen strong interest in event contracts, and analysts expect sports-related activity to support trading volumes as the new football season gets underway.

Robinhood Chain is another potential growth avenue for the company. The blockchain initiative is designed to facilitate the movement and trading of crypto assets, strengthening Robinhood's position in the rapidly expanding digital-asset ecosystem.

The broader cryptocurrency rally has also supported sentiment toward Robinhood shares. Strength in Bitcoin and other digital assets tends to benefit crypto-focused businesses and has helped lift investor interest in companies with significant exposure to the sector.

Recent analyst actions have strengthened the bullish backdrop for Robinhood. Morgan Stanley has a $150 target, Piper Sandler has a $145 target, while Scotiabank initiated coverage with a $136 target, reflecting growing confidence in the company's growth prospects.

Despite the positive analyst sentiment, Robinhood remains a volatile stock. The shares have experienced several sharp moves over the past year, meaning the latest rally represents a significant shift in investor sentiment and could be accompanied by further price swings.

Robinhood's latest rally reflects a combination of bullish analyst calls, prediction-market growth, cryptocurrency strength and business diversification. Wall Street increasingly sees Robinhood evolving from a cyclical retail brokerage into a broader financial-services platform, although its elevated valuation remains an important consideration for investors.
